meta.description: Remind parents on WhatsApp, get paid by UPI and keep every fee in one book. Free for home tutors in India. Join the waitlist.

hero.kicker: The fee register for home tutors. Free.
hero.title: Fees collected. Not chased.
hero.body: The notebook you already keep, soon one that reminds parents on WhatsApp and gets paid by UPI.

steps.title: Asking for money is awkward. So don't ask.

s1.title: You tap Remind
s1.body: WhatsApp opens with a polite message in the parent's language. You only press send.

s2.title: The parent taps Pay
s2.body: Their UPI app opens with your ID and the amount filled in. Nothing to install.

s3.title: The page gets stamped
s3.body: Money lands in your account. A numbered receipt goes to the parent.

t1.title: Fee receipt maker
t1.body: A proper PDF receipt in one minute.

t2.title: Fee reminder writer
t2.body: Polite or firm, with your UPI link inside.

p1.title: We never hold your money.
p1.body: UPI payments go from the parent's bank straight to your UPI ID.

p2.title: Parents install nothing.
p2.body: They open a link from WhatsApp. No app, no account.

p3.title: Built for a cheap phone and a slow network.
p3.body: Light pages that open fast on a basic Android phone, even on patchy 4G.

p4.title: We keep only what is needed.
p4.body: Name, batch, fee and attendance. Nothing else, and no ads.

waitlist.title: Put your name in the book.
waitlist.body: We will message you on WhatsApp the day the app opens.
